trophies.guide: The platinum is awarded automatically the moment the other 54 trophies are earned, so there is nothing extra to unlock beyond the full list. Plan around roughly 200 hours in a single playthrough: there are no difficulty settings, no online trophies and no New Game Plus to worry about. Keep cheats off for the entire run, because they disable trophies and saving, and keep a rotation of manual saves at chapter boundaries since missions cannot be replayed.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.guide: A story trophy for finishing Gone Fishing, the opening mission of Chapter 1. It unlocks automatically as the mission ends and cannot be missed, like every story trophy in the game. Just play the introduction and it is yours.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Awarded for completing Chapter 1. It actually pops shortly after the first main mission of Chapter 2 begins, so do not worry if it appears a few minutes later than expected. Automatic story progress, and before you leave Chapter 1 behind, make sure you have done the balcony meditation at Jason's house (see Positive Mental Attitude).
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Awarded for completing Chapter 2, and it unlocks once you are into the opening mission of Chapter 3, Welcome to Vice City. Automatic and unmissable. Chapter 2 also unlocks partner free-roam (Coffee Break), the garage purchases and the Scooter Bros app, so several side trophies open up from here.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Awarded for completing Chapter 3, popping after the first two main missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life. Automatic story progress and impossible to miss. Chapter 3 is a busy unlock chapter: Andy's and Tyrone's strands, Randy's Wish List, the Key Cloner and Yasmani's jewelry jobs all open during it.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Awarded for completing Chapter 4; it unlocks after the chapter's final main mission, Starting From Zero. Automatic and unmissable. Chapter 4 also brings the bank vault robbery chain through the optional mission That's Where The Money Is, which feeds three other trophies.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: The gold story trophy for completing the final mission of the game. It unlocks automatically at the end of the story, and free-roam continues afterwards, so every cleanup trophy can still be earned once it pops. Because there is no mission replay, keep a manual save near the end if you want a safety net, then move on to the 100% checklist.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.guide: A story trophy for completing Breakfast Run, a main mission in Chapter 2. It unlocks during the mission itself and cannot be missed. No preparation or optional objectives are involved.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: A story trophy for completing The Cartel Heist, a main mission in Chapter 3. It unlocks as part of the campaign and cannot be missed. Just finish the heist and the trophy follows.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: A story trophy for completing Child's Play, a main mission in Chapter 4. Automatic story progress; it unlocks during the campaign and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: A story trophy for completing Headliners, a main mission in Chapter 4. It unlocks automatically as the mission wraps up and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: A story trophy for completing VCIA Takedown, a main mission in Chapter 4 set around Vice City International Airport. Automatic and unmissable. The airport itself returns later for the Catch Me If You Can trophy, so remember the layout while you are there.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: A story trophy for completing Operation Savage Glory, a main mission in Chapter 5, the final chapter. It unlocks automatically during the endgame run and cannot be missed. You are close to the finale once this one pops.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the in-game completion checklist, which becomes viewable after the story under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, although everything you did earlier already counts. The checklist is forgiving — roughly 60% of everything in the game — and most collectible types and side quests are only partly required or not required at all. The demanding parts are the complete sets: all robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests, plus any 70 of the 80 challenges and 100 optional missions. Nothing toward it is missable, so treat it as the long post-story project that finishes the platinum.
trophies.name: A Long Road

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts across Leonida. They split into 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps, and you can mix categories freely; the bridge flights are the quickest to rack up. Track progress per region under Progress > Activities > Stunts, and note that the 100% checklist separately asks for 300 stunts, so keep going past the trophy if you are chasing A Long Road.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the nine activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a race or drone race, and performing a stunt. Most are introduced by the story, and the rest appear as blue dumbbell icons when you unfog the map. Check what you have under Touchpad > Progress > Activities — in practice this unlocks on its own while chasing the other trophies.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, spread across 12 shooting range locations. The gold scores are lenient, and range sessions also raise your Focus stat, which pays off later for the Gunslinger trophy. All 42 golds are required in full for the 100% checklist, so this silver sits right on the platinum's critical path.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations — 42 individual races exist across them, but you only need a win at every location, not a clean sweep of every race. Drone races are also required in full for the 100% checklist, so learn each course as you go rather than saving them all for the end.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. There are 40 unique race locations, so you can skip whichever ones frustrate you, but re-entering the same race does not add to the count — each win must be a distinct event. Work through them region by region so you always have fresh races nearby while doing other cleanup.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui introduces Cal, he texts you about a fishing spot, marked with a purple icon on the map west of Key Lento. Travel there, take on his challenge and out-fish him to unlock the trophy.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game, meaning finish all of its levels once. Four exist: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind are playable on the TV at home from Chapter 1 onward, while Bang For Your Buck sits on arcade machines out in the world. Pick whichever you enjoy most — the extra challenges inside the games are not required.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's stranger strand — five quests ending with her final mission. The strand is exclusive to Lucia: it is marked automatically in Chapter 3, when Andy calls Lucia and then texts her home address in Belville. Work through the Cellerica chain (Climbing the Cellerichain, Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass). Everything stays available after the story, so there is no deadline pressure.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's stranger strand, a series of treasure-diving jobs recovering shipwreck loot. Kenton Rees is marked with a green KR icon in Key Lento during Chapter 1, after Island Dreams; he sends you to seven shipwrecks, where you dig up treasure with the metal detector while diving, tracked under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees. He becomes unavailable for a while after Chapter 1 but returns during Chapter 2–3, and the whole strand remains doable after the story.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's stranger strand — five quests based at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County, marked automatically after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break. The chain runs Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler (steal the Impaler) and Hometown Heroes. All five quests stay available after the story, so finish them whenever it suits the route.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers. Not every side questline counts — the named character strands such as Andy, Billy, Tyrone and Moses do not count toward this total. Confirmed counting strands include Kirk's Skunk Ape hunt, Kyle's farm jobs, Yago's street-race strand (Race Against Yago appears in Chapter 3) and Pilot Pete's delivery flights. Your progress shows in the trophy tracker, and all strands remain available in free-roam after the story.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's strand, Randy's Wish List: deliver the 16 sports cars he wants. The list opens during the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, which also gives you the Key Cloner; Randy is marked RK in the west of Vice City and the list is tracked under Map > Robberies. Scan high-end cars with the WAiNK app to check them against the list — the east of Vice City around Ocean Beach is rich hunting — and deliver them undamaged for better pay.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's strand, which is exclusive to Jason. It is marked after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty: destroy the Synthetic Labs shown as purple markers around Vice City (the Take Out Kitty Litter job), and Tyrone then hands you the follow-up, Spin On This, which shuts the labs down for good and unlocks the trophy. The whole strand is still available after the story.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots, spread over 10 locations; meditating as both Jason and Lucia at a spot counts double toward the counter, tracked under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. The catch is the first one: during Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, Lucia talks about meditating in the kitchen at Jason's house in the morning and walks out to the balcony — follow her and choose Accept. That spot becomes permanently unavailable when Chapter 1 ends, and guides who tested it earned the trophy after doing it, so treat it as required. The final spot only opens once you can play as both characters together, after Coffee Break in Chapter 2.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret Vogel. Bret's strand is exclusive to Jason: after Coffee Break in Chapter 2, Bret texts Jason and marks Veteran Hunted in Lummox County, and he hands you the Killtelligence SM-69 hunting rifle, retrievable from any Ammu-Nation weapon locker. Work through his hunting requests — the Target Decks under Map > Activities, 15 in total and all needed for the 100% checklist — and bring the animals back to him; a clean one-shot kill keeps them pristine and pays more.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete any 3 full Collectible Card sets. There are 18 sets in the game, so pick the three whose cards are most accessible early. Keep collecting afterwards if you are chasing A Long Road: the 100% checklist separately wants 15 completed sets, so this silver is only the first milestone of a much longer collection.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app to scan 100 locations — landmarks, curiosities, sculptures and No Flusher tags all count, and there are more in the world than you need, so any 100 will do. Hold up on the D-pad to open the app instantly, then hold R1 on a highlighted object to scan it. Weave scans into ordinary travel and this silver finishes long before the platinum push.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the game's 80 challenges, arranged in eight groups of ten. Track them under Progress > Challenges, where finished ones carry a checkmark in the corner. Because the 100% checklist needs 70 of 80 anyway, this trophy normally unlocks by itself along the way — leave it late, then cherry-pick whichever remaining challenges look quickest.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, reach a 4-star wanted level and then lose it completely, escaping the red heat zone. Partner free-roam unlocks after Coffee Break in Chapter 2: call your partner in, cause enough carnage for four stars, then break line of sight — the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County is a reliable escape, since helicopters cannot track you inside. The trophy pops when you leave the heat zone, and the large bank vault robberies later trigger exactly the same situation automatically.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner while your wanted level never fully drops. Call your partner in after Coffee Break, keep the flashing search stars alive between stores, and loot a couple of items in each shop; the three jewelry stores in the north of Vice City (opened by Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3) work well, including cracking the back-room safe with sticky bombs. The unlock is delayed by about half a minute after the third shop — if it does not pop, rob a fourth and keep going.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles by scanning them with the WAiNK app: hold up on the D-pad, look at a vehicle and hold R1. You never need to drive them, and boats and aircraft count as well as cars and bikes. Standing on a busy road and scanning passing traffic is the fastest method; since the 100% checklist wants 200 of the 277 base models scanned, this unlocks naturally if you scan new vehicles as you meet them.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during a single Combat Focus activation — L3 plus R3 while aiming — which slows time and highlights weak points but only lasts a few seconds. Prepare first: eat, drink or shower to top up Focus, take Adrenaline to extend it, wear body armor, and use an accurate full-auto rifle such as the Duke 556 against a packed group at a gang operation. It does not work on police, soldiers or civilians, and it gets much easier at Focus level 4, which rises through shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a passenger jet that is docked at a boarding bridge at VCIA, Vice City International Airport — planes parked on the open airfield do not count. The easiest is at terminals E3/E4: enter by the stairs beside the bridge, go up to the cockpit, reverse out onto the strip, take off and fly about a kilometre away from the airport. The trophy unlocks with a short delay once you are clear.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Steal a Rhino tank from Mile Zero Air Station, the island base at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County, where the tanks stand in the south of the base. Slip in through the gate or via the stunt jump by the south-east entrance, climb into a tank and fire on enemies until the trophy pops. Expect heavy resistance on the way out — the tank itself is the safest seat in the county.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Finish Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 to receive the Snap Gun, which silently picks alarmed back doors instead of kicking them in. Enter through the back, find the note with the safe code, loot the safe, and destroy the security footage and disable the alarm in the back room before leaving. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good target, and the trophy unlocks shortly after you walk out.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. The Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is introduces the job: tail a security van until a guard carries cash into the bank, slip into the vault while it stands open, and hand a bag to your partner because you cannot carry it all alone. Afterwards Yasmani sells van tips for $10,000 that mark the vans with purple icons. Every vault triggers a 4-star wanted level, so escape on a fast motorcycle and switch vehicles; there are 8 large bank jobs in total and the 100% checklist wants all of them.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape the heat. It unlocks automatically during That's Where The Money Is in Chapter 4, because robbing a large bank vault counts as robbing the truck that stocked it. To do it earlier, block a roaming armored truck near a bank, blow its rear doors open with a sticky bomb (stocked at Yasmani's shop after his Chapter 3 jobs), grab the cash and escape the red heat radius before the trophy registers.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Fully unfog the map by exploring all 52 areas of Leonida. The practical method is a plane: fly slow passes over every remaining blacked-out region until the whole map is revealed. Coastal strips and the islands are the easiest to forget, so finish with a careful sweep around the shoreline and the Keys.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 operations in total, marked with yellow icons as you approach them, and your per-gang progress shows under Progress > Gangs. The 100% checklist requires all 39 anyway, so this unlocks on the way if you clear operations as you find them rather than saving them for a dedicated sweep.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach, buy an Apple Martini, and drink it while standing next to the bar, taking in the view. That is the whole trophy: a small nostalgia stop that takes under a minute once you are standing there.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal the blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City and drive it straight out through the showroom window. You need the Key Cloner from the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS before the car can be taken. Only that specific Banshee counts — it is a nod to the famous Banshee from GTA III — and the trophy pops a few seconds after you reach the street.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, a gang operation first marked during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling. Bring sticky bombs from Ammu-Nation: the luxury watch is in the south-east office, the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun sits on a table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway office must be blown open. The trophy unlocks after you escape the police, and the three items do not all have to be taken in a single visit.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Have maximum Strength on both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Strength is checked under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia, and the pair can only train together after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. Buy a fitness club membership, call your partner in, and work out: the partner trains automatically alongside you, so both bars rise together. After the story you can also work out at home, which makes the final stretch easy.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile — robberies, encounters and escapes all count, across the Professional, Hardened, Violent and Psycho ratings. Turn on criminal profile notifications under Settings > UI > HUD Notifications so you can watch the counter move, and check progress by selecting the trophy in the trophy list. It accumulates passively across a platinum run; just avoid the permanent Irredeemable status, which makes police far more aggressive for the rest of the game.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Return as Lucia, alone, to the Payday Loans store in Little Cuba, Vice City — the one she robs in the prologue — rob it a second time, and escape on foot. It is available from Chapter 2, once Lucia is playable: aim at the teller, take the money and run until the delayed unlock triggers. Driving away voids it, so stay on foot the whole way out.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: Complete the UFO easter egg on the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County. Come solo, at night after 2 AM, and look for a blinking car at the roadside — the spawn is random, so drive away and come back if it is not there. Follow the path into the woods toward the bright blue light, approach the UFO, then help the woman it drops back to her car at the roadside to unlock the trophy.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: On a motorcycle, kick 10 pedestrians with the melee drive-by attack within 60 seconds. Crowded pavements are essential — Ocean Beach and the central Vice City sidewalks give you the density you need. Keep your speed moderate so the kicks actually connect, and chain along one long street rather than wasting the minute on turns.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder a total of $250,000 in Marked Bills through fences, accumulated across all robberies — it does not need to arrive in one delivery. Finish Credit Check in Chapter 3 to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer, then rob banks and Payday Loans and sell the bills to a fence; Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The bank vaults from Chapter 4 can yield up to $205,000 in a few minutes, so this completes quickly once they open.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend a total of $100,000 across all shops. The fastest sinks are the expensive ones: weapons at the 24 Ammu-Nations, vehicle mods at the 14 mod shops, and tattoos at the 11 studios, with clothing, salons and electronics stores adding up in the background. Ordinary play plus property spending carries you most of the way, so check the remaining gap late in the run and top it up with big-ticket purchases.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garage properties — the 4 story garages do not count toward this. They cost $160,000 in total and are bought through the Vice City Real Estate app, which is installed on your phone after Daily Driver in Chapter 2. Robberies are the quickest funding, especially the higher-value jobs in Chapters 3–4. Garages matter beyond this trophy: their parking spots cap how many vehicles you can register for On the Spot.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app, which is installed after the Chapter 2 mission Moses. Take stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray and Register in his garage; registered vehicles can then be delivered to you anywhere. You need enough garage parking spots first, so buy garages as you go, and register cheap low-end cars and bikes to keep the fees down. From Chapter 3, cars with standard trackers can also be registered at any Pay 'n' Spray.
trophies.name: On the Spot
